Odysseus.rationale: Four materially different states: wandering/voyage engine, Nobody/Cyclops deception, Thesprotian war-king, and late return to Ithaca.

Penelope.rationale: Patient household ruler, mythic weaving centerpiece, and post-suitor household anchor. Redundant waiting-state version was removed.

Telegonus.rationale: Two uncommon signposts encode voyage/search and stranger/heir states across different archetypes; rare stingray-spear version is the fatal climax.

Telemachus.rationale: Young heir, returned fighting son/RW signpost, and post-Odyssey heir are distinct chronological and mechanical states.

Antinous.rationale: WB uncommon establishes suitor signpost identity; mono-black rare is the consuming-household antagonist.

Apollo.rationale: Post-Odyssey separator of divine combat and Trojan defender are separate narrative functions.

Ares.rationale: Post-Odyssey rout of the Thesprotians and Trojan-war god embodiment are separate uses.

Athena.rationale: Core Odyssey guide and later opponent of Ares are different narrative eras and jobs.

Calypso.rationale: GU uncommon signpost plus mythic Ogygia/exile centerpiece.

Circe.rationale: UB uncommon signpost plus mythic prepared transformation centerpiece.

Tiresias.rationale: UB uncommon is archetype signpost; rare foretell version is the premium prophecy card.
